physics_selection_reasons.reason: Worker restart can lose volatile state and replay side effects.
A tool batch can partially succeed and leave uncertain state.
Database connection pressure and write amplification affect reliability.

insufficient_physics.description: Bounded resource consumer with a hard capacity limit
insufficient_physics.reason: No registered primitive models the stated hard capacity bound on edge proxy consumers.
evidence: Architecture description mentions a bounded consumer or hard capacity limit (in-memory limits: Allocates bounded internal memory structures and fixed-size rule/feature arrays sized according to documented maximum feature capacities).

insufficient_physics.reason: The architecture describes replication or eventual consistency, but the corresponding consistency primitive was not selected or cannot simulate asynchronous background deduplication merges.
evidence: The ReplacingMergeTree engine deduplicates records with matching sorting keys asynchronously during background part merges. Queries without explicit aggregation or FINAL read unmerged parts and may observe duplicate rows.
